question: What claim is made about the uniqueness of the knowledge in relation to this teaching?
premises: There is knowledge equal to this.
Such knowledge will not exist again.
Nor will it exist in the future as equal to this.
inference: No knowledge equal to this exists, nor will any equal knowledge arise again.
uncertainties: The scope of 'again' is not temporally specified.
plain_english: No knowledge equal to this exists, nor will it exist again.
